        CLI_SHELL_COMPLETION_ENABLE = HAS_AUTOCOMPLETE_SUPPORT

", "explanation": "In Pydantic V2 the nested `class Config` is deprecated. Per migration.md#changes-to-config, config should be set as a `model_config` dict. The key CLI_SHELL_COMPLETION_ENABLE is kept unchanged as the finding requires."}], "notes": "Applied one finding (config-class). Caveat: the old nested Config inherited from ExampleConfigDefaults, which is defined in pydantic_cli/examples/__init__.py and was not provided. Any settings defined there are NOT carried over by this edit, and the ExampleConfigDefaults import has been removed because it is now unused. Before relying on this, confirm ExampleConfigDefaults is empty or that its keys are merged into model_config. If it has settings, they should be spread into the ConfigDict call or that file should be migrated too. The rest of the file (Field usage with title/description/gt/cli extras, Optional, run_and_exit) is already v2-compatible and needs no change."}
